problem: A configured working directory can appear correct in logs while a login shell or an untested executor boundary writes relative artifacts under another directory.
scope: verification expansion, string command normalization, subprocess execution, systemd/PTY execution, frozen smoke verification, and progressive operator evidence
baseline: String commands use /bin/sh -lc; verification requires case and seed; cwd tests assert printed PWD but do not assert positive and negative filesystem effects.
benchmarks: Python subprocess cwd changes directory before child execution
systemd WorkingDirectory sets the directory for executed processes
GNU Make CURDIR reports the directory after -C processing
W3C disclosure keeps secondary controls explicit and stateful
advantages: The task snapshot already freezes an absolute working directory
Both executors already have explicit cwd boundaries
Lifecycle logs already expose the frozen command and cwd
disadvantages: The login-shell flag permits startup files to change process context
Existing systemd coverage observes text rather than durable relative side effects
Runtime and packaged verification plugin copies had divergent command behavior
limitations: Windows development tests cannot prove Linux /bin/sh profile behavior
Real systemd and frozen binary gates require the Ubuntu quality environment
A user command may intentionally change directory after LocalFlow starts it
defects: verification rejects commands without case and seed placeholders
tracked runtime verification plugin invents --case and --seed
string commands invoke a login shell
cwd oracle lacks negative root-artifact assertion
bottlenecks: browser evidence must be regenerated after UI source changes

metrics.name: known command-form acceptance
metrics.measurement: parameterized plugin expansion for no variables, case only, seed only, and both

metrics.name: configured-directory side-effect accuracy
metrics.measurement: target marker exists and same-name LocalFlow-root marker is absent

metrics.name: login-profile exposure
metrics.measurement: command contract assertion and repository search

hypotheses: Removing login-shell startup files preserves the executor-provided cwd
Filesystem side-effect assertions detect cwd failures that printed PWD assertions can miss
Optional placeholder substitution preserves generic verification commands without guessed arguments
allowed_variables: cwd test fixtures and progressive diagnostic documentation

stages.input: user requirements and existing command/plugin contracts
stages.output: optional placeholder and non-login shell specification
relative marker only under target directory
stages.checker: subprocess, systemd Make, and frozen smoke tests

stages.input: resolved cwd, command, and diagnostic depth
stages.output: progressive path evidence without routine low-level noise
stages.checker: skill text, browser inspection, and task log assertions

hard_gates: known success fixtures accepted and known failure mutants rejected
no plugin-enforced case or seed placeholder
target marker exists and LocalFlow-root marker is absent
quality trace and relevant browser geometry remain current
failure_fixtures: make all rejected for missing case and seed
relative marker appears below LocalFlow root
success_fixtures: make all with no placeholders remains exact
case-only and seed-only commands substitute only requested variables
relative mkdir and marker writes occur only in the external project
visible Run Configuration action remains below left navigation tabs
fault_injections: change executor cwd to LocalFlow root
move disclosure button into task content
rollback: Return to the earliest failing contract, executor, or UI hierarchy stage and rerun all dependent gates.

iteration_budget.review_trigger: second same-direction failure or unavailable Ubuntu/browser target

stop_conditions: Ubuntu systemd and frozen artifact side-effect gates pass before release claim
project skill writeback and quality trace validation pass

promotion_decision.reason: The rule is reusable across LocalFlow configurations but depends on LocalFlow executor and UI contracts.

writeback: Add a progressive working-directory disclosure section to the project configuration skill and update project research and quality evidence.
